why: The e-Tax Guide lists SR among the codes of standard-rated supplies to submit
Export sales of goods and international services are submitted with ZR
Exempt supplies use ES33 or ESN33 and exempt financial services are excluded: the choice is not made by the pack
Import permits for importation of goods are an excluded transaction
Purchases from non-GST registered suppliers are not reported in the return
Purchases where input tax is blocked are not reported in the return
